'''Television commercials''' for Star Wars CCG are the broadcast spots Decipher ran for the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] in 1996.

The surviving 31-second spot is [[Star Wars CCG TV Ad (1996)]]. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG TV Ad (1996) (transcript)]]. Other Decipher spots, including later [[WARS TCG]] commercials, are listed at [[Decipher promotional videos]].
